messages:
Ava (Design): quick QA on the vectors preview header: legend + export buttons wrap badly on tablet. Proposal: sticky header with legend left, density center, export/actions right.
Zach (Eng): sticky header is doable. Concern: keyboard order and focus when header sticks.
Carmen (A11y): fine if legend items are focusable and have aria-labels. color swatches need text alternatives and shape indicators for contrast.
Ava (Design): we'll add short text labels and optional shape icons. also add a high-contrast toggle.
Jon (PM): product ask: keep export next to actions so users can export what they're previewing. last split caused confusion.
Zach (Eng): noted. export + bulk actions grouped right. cap preview to 100 rows to avoid DOM slowness; show banner: "Previewing 100 of 10,000 vectors. Export will include all unless sampled."
Liam (ML): rerank score shows bare numbers (e.g., 0.83). Can we add context? maybe "score (0-1)" or an sr-only description.
Carmen (A11y): prefer sr-only explanatory node referenced by aria-describedby. avoid transient tooltips as sole method. Use polite live region only for summary updates.
Ava (Design): export modal copy: change "Download vectors" to "Export vectors (CSV)" with subtext "Includes id, truncated dims, rerank_score". Add sampling dropdown: First N, Random (default 1000), Stratified.
Zach (Eng): will implement sr-only descriptions, banner role=note, dismissible with `aria-label="Dismiss preview notice"`. Analytics event on density toggle OK.
ui-bot: deploy-preview ready at https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/vector-header-fix (branch: design/vector-header-fix)
Ava (Design): I'll test keyboard flow and update mock. Carmen, can you do a quick VoiceOver/NVDA check once PR is up?
Carmen (A11y): will do. blocking only until aria-describedby/live-region approach is in PR.
Jon (PM): timeline: aim to ship behind feature flag next week.
Zach (Eng): opening PR today. Thanks! :thumbsup:
